entities.summary: Rodrigo de Arriaga was a Spanish philosopher, theologian and Jesuit. He is known as one of the foremost Spanish Jesuits of his day and as a leading representative of post-Suárezian baroque Jesuit nominalism. According to Richard Popkin, Arriaga was “the last of the great Spanish Scholastics”.
